headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 4, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals secured a convincing 13-7 victory over the New York Yankees, with Alec Burleson leading the charge at the plate. Burleson's impressive performance included three home runs and six RBIs.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries and availability. Dalton Rushing, the Los Angeles Dodgers catcher, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Additionally, Zac Gallen of the Arizona Diamondbacks has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with right elbow inflammation, while Mitch Keller of the Pittsburgh Pirates has been placed on the 60-day injured list with a right arm teres major muscle injury.

The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Seth Johnson to the Athletics in exchange for RF Colby Thomas, while the Miami Marlins traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall to Phillies in 6-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals suffered a 6-3 defeat at the hands of the Philadelphia Phillies. Derek Hill led the Nationals' offense with a home run and four RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Blast Past Yankees 13-7**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a convincing 13-7 victory over the New York Yankees, with Alec Burleson leading the charge at the plate. Burleson's impressive performance included three home runs and six RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling 4-3 Victory Over Brewers**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers in a close game, winning 4-3. Spencer Horwitz led the Pirates' offense with 3 RBIs on a single hit in 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Fall to Cubs in 5-10 Thrashing**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dominated the Los Angeles Dodgers in a lopsided 5-10 victory, handing the Dodgers their loss. Michael Busch led the Dodgers' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Dalton Rushing Placed on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers catcher Dalton Rushing has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. The move was made on August 3, 2026.

top_news.title: **Athletics Acquire RHP Seth Johnson in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Seth Johnson to the Athletics in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. The trade was finalized on August 3, 2026.
